editorial.blurb: Trilokah brings authentic Kerala and South Indian cuisine to Lincoln Park with dishes crafted with genuine care, from perfectly layered porotta to fragrant dum biryani.
editorial.insiderTip: Order the classics like lamb chops, dum biryani, and porotta curries rather than daily specials for the most reliable authentic taste; go early and dine in rather than delivery for the full experience, and mention if you're spice-sensitive so they can adjust.
